name: Vanta
description: Query and manage compliance controls, tests, evidence, vendors, vulnerabilities, and policies.
notes: Uses Vanta's official hosted MCP server. Vanta Admin access is required. The endpoint is region-specific and currently in beta for all customers.
installHint: Use https://mcp.vanta.com/mcp for US tenants, https://mcp.eu.vanta.com/mcp for EU tenants, or https://mcp.aus.vanta.com/mcp for Australian tenants. Edit the MCP URL to match your Vanta region, then sign in with a Vanta Admin account.
